title: Integrating surface coating and quasi-solid deep eutectic electrolytes for enhanced cycling of micro-Si anodes in Li-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01640H, Communication
Natthawut Suebsing, Pauline Jaumaux, Javad Safaei, Cherdsak Bootjomchai, Asif Mahmood, Udom Tipparach, Guoxiu Wang
An improved cycling performance is reported of micro-Si-based anodes obtained by surface coating and quasi-solid deep eutectic solvent electrolytes for high-performance and stable lithium-ion batteries.
